question_set.question: Use find_extremes in order to know Which city has the most consistent temperature pattern throughout the months?

answer.value: Miami has the most consistent temperature pattern with a steady increase from 22C in January to 31C in June, showing a predictable and gradual warming trend. Seattle also shows a consistent upward trend but with more moderate temperatures, while Denver has the most variable pattern with a wider temperature range.

key_insights: Miami has most consistent temperature pattern
All cities show upward temperature trend from January to June

reasoning_trace.rationale: Use find_extremes to identify temperature patterns across cities and months
